verses.original: οὖν Χριστοῦ παθόντος σαρκὶ ὑμεῖς καὶ ὁπλίσασθε τὴν αὐτὴν ἔννοιαν ὅτι ὁ παθὼν σαρκὶ πέπαυται ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: oun Christou pathontos sarki hymeis kai hoplisasthe tēn autēn ennoian hoti ho pathōn sarki pepautai hamartias
verses.literal: Therefore, since Christ suffered in [His] body - - arm yourselves with the same resolve because anyone who has suffered [in his] body is done with sin

verses.original: εἰς μηκέτι βιῶσαι τὸ τὸν ἐπίλοιπον χρόνον ἐν σαρκὶ ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαις ἀλλὰ θελήματι Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: eis mēketi biōsai to ton epiloipon chronon en sarki anthrōpōn epithymiais alla thelēmati Theou
verses.literal: Consequently vvv he does not live out - [his] remaining time vvv on earth for human passions but for [the] will of God

verses.original: γὰρ ἀρκετὸς ὁ χρόνος παρεληλυθὼς κατειργάσθαι τὸ βούλημα τῶν ἐθνῶν πεπορευμένους ἐν ἀσελγείαις ἐπιθυμίαις οἰνοφλυγίαις κώμοις πότοις καὶ ἀθεμίτοις εἰδωλολατρίαις
verses.transliteration: gar arketos ho chronos parelēlythōs kateirgasthai to boulēma tōn ethnōn peporeumenous en aselgeiais epithymiais oinophlygiais kōmois potois kai athemitois eidōlolatriais
verses.literal: For [you have spent] enough - time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles living in debauchery lust drunkenness orgies carousing and detestable idolatry

verses.original: Ἐν ᾧ ξενίζονται ὑμῶν μὴ συντρεχόντων εἰς τὴν αὐτὴν ἀνάχυσιν τῆς ἀσωτίας βλασφημοῦντες
verses.transliteration: En hō xenizontai hymōn mē syntrechontōn eis tēn autēn anachysin tēs asōtias blasphēmountes
verses.literal: Because of this they consider it strange of you not to plunge with [them] into the same flood - of reckless indiscretion [and] they heap abuse on you

verses.original: οἳ ἀποδώσουσιν λόγον τῷ ἔχοντι ἑτοίμως κρῖναι ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς
verses.transliteration: hoi apodōsousin logon tō echonti hetoimōs krinai zōntas kai nekrous
verses.literal: [But they] will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge [the] living and [the] dead

verses.original: γὰρ εἰς τοῦτο εὐηγγελίσθη καὶ νεκροῖς ἵνα κριθῶσι μὲν κατὰ ἀνθρώπους σαρκί δὲ ζῶσι κατὰ Θεὸν πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: gar eis touto euēngelisthē kai nekrois hina krithōsi men kata anthrōpous sarki de zōsi kata Theon pneumati
verses.literal: vvv vvv That is why the gospel was preached even to [those who are now] dead so that they might be judged - as men in [the] flesh but live according to God in [the] spirit

verses.original: δὲ τὸ τέλος Πάντων ἤγγικεν οὖν σωφρονήσατε καὶ νήψατε εἰς προσευχάς
verses.transliteration: de to telos Pantōn ēngiken oun sōphronēsate kai nēpsate eis proseuchas
verses.literal: - The end of all [things] is near Therefore be clear-minded and sober so that you can pray

verses.original: πρὸ πάντων τὴν ἀγάπην εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἔχοντες ἐκτενῆ ὅτι ἀγάπη καλύπτει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: pro pantōn tēn agapēn eis heautous echontes ektenē hoti agapē kalyptei plēthos hamartiōn
verses.literal: Above all - love vvv one another vvv deeply because love covers over a multitude of sins
Show hospitality to one another without complaining

verses.original: ὡς καλοὶ οἰκονόμοι ποικίλης χάριτος Θεοῦ καθὼς ἕκαστος εἰς αὐτὸ χάρισμα ἔλαβεν διακονοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς
verses.transliteration: hōs kaloi oikonomoi poikilēs charitos Theou kathōs hekastos eis auto charisma elaben diakonountes heautous
verses.literal: As good stewards of [the] manifold grace of God - each [of you] [should use] whatever gift he has received to serve one another

verses.original: εἴ τις λαλεῖ ὡς Θεοῦ λόγια εἴ τις διακονεῖ ὡς ἐξ ἰσχύος ἧς ὁ Θεός χορηγεῖ ἵνα ἐν πᾶσιν ὁ Θεὸς δοξάζηται διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: ei tis lalei hōs Theou logia ei tis diakonei hōs ex ischyos hēs ho Theos chorēgei hina en pasin ho Theos doxazētai dia Iēsou Christou hō estin hē doxa kai to kratos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: If anyone speaks [he should speak] as vvv one conveying the words of God If anyone serves [he should serve] with [the] strength - - God provides so that in all things - God may be glorified through Jesus Christ to whom be the glory and the power vvv vvv forever [and] ever Amen

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί μὴ ξενίζεσθε τῇ πυρώσει πρὸς πειρασμὸν ὑμῖν γινομένῃ ἐν ὑμῖν ὡς ξένου συμβαίνοντος ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi mē xenizesthe tē pyrōsei pros peirasmon hymin ginomenē en hymin hōs xenou symbainontos hymin
verses.literal: Beloved {do} not be surprised at the fiery - trial - that has come upon you as though something strange were happening to you

verses.original: ἀλλὰ χαίρετε καθὸ κοινωνεῖτε τοῖς παθήμασιν τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα καὶ χαρῆτε ἀγαλλιώμενοι ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τῆς αὐτοῦ δόξης
verses.transliteration: alla chairete katho koinōneite tois pathēmasin tou Christou hina kai charēte agalliōmenoi en tē apokalypsei tēs autou doxēs
verses.literal: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings - of Christ so that . . . you may be overjoyed . . . at the revelation of His glory

verses.original: Εἰ ὀνειδίζεσθε ἐν ὀνόματι Χριστοῦ μακάριοι ὅτι τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς δόξης καὶ τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀναπαύεται ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ei oneidizesthe en onomati Christou makarioi hoti to Pneuma tēs doxēs kai to tou Theou anapauetai eph’ hymas
verses.literal: If you are insulted for [the] name of Christ [you are] blessed because the Spirit - of glory and - - of God rests on you

verses.original: γάρ μὴ τις ὑμῶν πασχέτω ὡς φονεὺς ἢ κλέπτης ἢ κακοποιὸς ἢ ὡς ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος
verses.transliteration: gar mē tis hymōn paschetō hōs phoneus ē kleptēs ē kakopoios ē hōs allotriepiskopos
verses.literal: Indeed vvv [none] of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer or even as a meddler

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ὡς Χριστιανός μὴ αἰσχυνέσθω δὲ δοξαζέτω τὸν Θεὸν ἐν τούτῳ τῷ ὀνόματι
verses.transliteration: de ei hōs Christianos mē aischynesthō de doxazetō ton Theon en toutō tō onomati
verses.literal: But if [you suffer] as a Christian vvv do not be ashamed but glorify - God [that you bear] that - name

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ καιρὸς τὸ κρίμα τοῦ ἄρξασθαι ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ Θεοῦ δὲ εἰ πρῶτον ἀφ’ ἡμῶν τί τὸ τέλος τῶν ἀπειθούντων τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoti ho kairos to krima tou arxasthai apo tou oikou tou Theou de ei prōton aph’ hēmōn ti to telos tōn apeithountōn tō euangeliō tou Theou
verses.literal: For [it is] - time [for] - judgment - to begin with the family - of God and if it begins with us what [will] the outcome [be] for those who disobey the gospel - of God

verses.original: καὶ Εἰ μόλις ὁ δίκαιος σώζεται ποῦ φανεῖται ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς
verses.transliteration: kai Ei molis ho dikaios sōzetai pou phaneitai ho asebēs kai hamartōlos
verses.literal: And If it is hard for the righteous to be saved what will become of the ungodly and [the] sinner

verses.original: Ὥστε καὶ οἱ πάσχοντες κατὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸ θέλημα παρατιθέσθωσαν αὐτῶν τὰς ψυχὰς πιστῷ Κτίστῃ ἐν ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hōste kai hoi paschontes kata tou Theou to thelēma paratithesthōsan autōn tas psychas pistō Ktistē en agathopoiia
verses.literal: So then . . . those who suffer according to - God’s - will should entrust their - souls to [their] faithful Creator and continue to do good
